New editor atlas panel is whole-model, no part correspondence. (Q) GIZMO VIEW-ANGLE SCALING — old studio grows the translate gizmo dramatically when the drag axis is near-perpendicular to camera (moving sideways vs head-on) = precise tuning. Host-side gizmo behavior (Zig).
